about: Natural-work prompt set for V1 vs v1(a). Decisions are said in normal sentences and inside the agent's replies (not as 'Final decision:' lines). Session 3 starts after a simulated long gap in which our map's old rows were cleaned up, so only the tools can still remember them.

files.src/invoice.ts:
export function sendInvoice() {}
export function renderInvoicePdf() {}

prompts.prompt: we're building an invoicing service, customers should get a PDF invoice by email after every payment
prompts.reply: Got it. I'll start with sendInvoice in src/invoice.ts and renderInvoicePdf for the PDF.

prompts.prompt: for rate limiting I think redis is better than memcached here, let's just go with redis
prompts.reply: Agreed. rateLimit in src/ratelimit.ts now uses Redis with a sliding window of 100 requests per minute per API key.

prompts.prompt: how should we deal with stripe sending the same webhook more than once?
prompts.reply: Stripe retries webhooks for up to 3 days, so I made handleStripeWebhook idempotent: it stores each event id in the processed_events table and skips events it has already seen.

prompts.prompt: run the tests please
prompts.reply: One failure: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'amount') in calculateTax when the cart has no line items. I added a guard so empty carts get zero tax.

prompts.prompt: the pdf looks broken on phones
prompts.reply: renderInvoicePdf had a fixed 800px width; I removed it and switched the page to A4 with 12mm margins, so it scales on phones now.

prompts.prompt: finance asked that invoices never come from the noreply address, customers need to be able to answer them, use billing@ourco.com
prompts.reply: Understood. sendEmail now always sends invoices from billing@ourco.com.

prompts.prompt: how are we storing money amounts?
prompts.reply: All amounts are stored as integer cents, with the currency in a separate ISO 4217 column. calculateTax never uses floats.

prompts.prompt: our EU customers need VAT on their invoices
prompts.reply: calculateTax now applies VAT by the customer's billing country. Business customers with a valid VAT number get reverse charge, so no VAT is added for them.

prompts.prompt: sounds good
legal says we have to keep the invoice PDFs for 7 years
prompts.reply: Done. Invoice PDFs go to the invoices-archive bucket with a 7-year retention rule.
